name: lee-internal-comps
description: Internal (Dealius) and external lease & sale comps, demographic reports, and owner-of-record lookup for authorized Lee & Associates Raleigh brokers. Eighteen skills: internal-comps (Dealius mirror, Excel + Lee-branded PDF), external-comps (weekly external snapshot via typed MCP tools, Excel + Markdown table), demographic-summary (1/3/5 mi single-page Lee infographic for any NC address, JSON + Lee-branded PDF with 1-hour signed link), demographic-detail (multi-page Demographic and Income Profile with inline SVG charts, race/income breakdowns, 2020/2025/2030 projections via gi_permit_adjusted with Census BPS add-back, Family HHs + Owner HUs trend bars, four Esri-analog indices, and Lee-branded PDF), business-key-facts (BAO-style Business Key Facts 3-page landscape PDF for any NC address: key statistics, households table, site map with 1/3/5 mile rings, education attainment + workforce charts, population/housing growth), and owner-lookup (owner of record + mailing address + assessor facts for any property in Wake, Durham, New Hanover, or Lee NC, sub-second from a bulk-staged D1 owner graph of ~2M parcels/owners/links), and daily-debrief (Will-only interview-style classification of yesterday's broker requests: walks through each plugin session AND each off-plugin ask one-by-one, capturing the off-plugin category (plugin_broke / known_gap / new_opportunity) so the rollup drives the roadmap conversation), and tenants-in-market (scheduled Cowork ingest of Triangle Pairlist tenant-requirement emails: screens each as a tenant requirement vs a listing and writes every screened email to a shared, queryable tenant_requirements store via the lee_tenant_requirement_write MCP tool; analyst/automation skill, not broker-invoked), and owner-mailing-list (deduplicated owner + mailing-address CSV for an area + criteria request: queries the pre-staged NC OneMap statewide parcel mirror via the pull_owner_mailing_list MCP tool — radius + acreage + land-class criteria, private owners only, results in seconds, no browser extension; Wake, Durham, New Hanover, Lee, Orange, Johnston, Chatham NC), and internal-and-external-comps (the default all-comps skill: an unqualified comps request pulls BOTH internal Dealius and external CoStar in parallel and returns one combined chat table, Excel, and a Lee-branded unified PDF tagged by source -- sale and lease), and add-comps (normalize a contributed comp set a broker pastes, forwards, or uploads -- a forwarded email with several brokerage comp tables, an xlsx/csv, a pasted table, or a screenshot -- into canonical records tagged by source/provenance and ingest them as a third source via the lee_comps_add_write MCP tool, queryable across all three sources via pull_unified_comps; lease and sale; analyst/operator skill), and labor-shed (per-ring 1/3/5 mile resident (RAC) + workplace (WAC) workforce sliced by NAICS sector for any NC address, with the industrial-family subtotal -- construction, manufacturing, wholesale, transportation & warehousing -- called out; wraps the lee-raleigh-mcp pull_labor_shed tool), and lee-flyer-brief (guided marketing-flyer intake for a listing: auto-pulls owner, comps, business key facts, and demographics for an address or an uploaded listing agreement, then runs each component through present -> augment -> select -> narrate so the broker adds their own data and chooses exactly what makes the flyer, writes a provenance-tagged flyer brief, and hands off carry-over instructions into Claude Design for visual polish; replaces Lee marketing's Formstack New Listing Marketing Request intake), and vpd-lookup (top-5 nearby road segments by AADT / vehicles-per-day for any NC address, ranked by road class then volume, with the count year + distance and a ready-to-place flyer card; wraps the lee-raleigh-mcp pull_vpd_lookup tool), and nearby-businesses (Area Amenities map kit for any NC address: the recognizable nearby businesses (grocery, retail, restaurants, coffee, gyms, pharmacies, hotels, healthcare) ranked by prominence with their brand logos, returned as a downloadable designer kit -- basemap + logo images + a placements manifest -- that the marketing team composes into the flyer's amenities map in Claude Design; wraps the lee-raleigh-mcp pull_nearby_businesses tool), and comp-map (Lee-branded competitive-set map for an NC listing: deal mode maps the comps around a subject address with numbered pins, distance rings, and a matching numbered comp table; database mode maps the whole internal set or a broker's deal history; returns a shareable ~30-day interactive Google map link + a print-ready static PNG + a csm-* comp-table fragment for flyers/OMs/BOVs; wraps the lee-raleigh-mcp pull_comp_map tool), and development-pipeline (the commercial development pipeline around any covered NC address: what's being built, approved, or under review within a radius, from 12 pre-staged municipal feeds (Triangle, Harnett, Lee County NC, New Hanover/Wilmington), with stage counts, per-category exclusion breakdown, flyer-ready narrative bullet lines, a dpt-* flyer fragment, and a component PDF; wraps the lee-raleigh-mcp pull_development_pipeline tool). Plus process-mapping: a guided interview that maps any team member's repeatable process into a clean process-map document for GI (CRE = firm context, role-agnostic).
